item.title: Iran targeted by fresh strikes as US warns of 'most intense day'
item.summary: Several cities in #Iran were targeted by fresh Israeli strikes as the US-Israeli campaign carried on in the country. US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth on March 10 warned it would be the "most intense day" of strikes in the country.

item.title: Iran vows to fight 'as long as needed' as Trump says war will end 'soon'
item.summary: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tuesday his country would keep fighting as long as necessary, casting doubt on US President Donald Trump's insistence that the conflict would be over "soon."
